title: Longest Increasing Path in a Matrix
keyIdea: memo[r][c] = longest strictly increasing path starting at (r, c) = 1 + max over bigger neighbours. Values strictly increase along a path, so there are no cycles; DFS with memo solves each cell once.

approaches.name: DFS + memo
approaches.idea: I wrote this one (you didn't paste code). dfs(r, c) returns memo if set; else 1 + best dfs of each larger neighbour; answer = max over all cells.
approaches.why: Each cell is computed once and looks at 4 neighbours; memo plus recursion stack.

quiz.q: Why is no visited set needed?
options: Paths strictly increase, so they can never return to a cell (no cycles)
The longest increasing path that starts at (r, c)
The longest path ending at (r, c) only
